verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions AVX, AVX2, AVX512, or AMX instruction-set support. It only says llamafile runs CPU inference on most operating systems and CPU architectures, plus one anecdotal speed report, and neither establishes the product's own use of advanced x86 instruction sets. The axis applies to a local inference runtime, so the absence of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can leverage advanced x86 CPU instruction sets like AVX, AVX2, AVX512, and AMX for faster inference
